$comment: The environment this package reads, declared where a caller can find it (NR-ENV / FR-DATA-001). Data, not code: `fylite describe` publishes it and `test_environment_table.py` holds it against the source both ways — a variable the code reads and this file does not name is a failure, and so is an entry naming a variable nothing reads. Each entry also declares `affects_result`: whether the variable can change a NUMBER the run delivers, with the reason. `env_fingerprint()` records exactly the ones marked true, so what a run was reproducible from is read off the declaration rather than remembered.

FYLITE_DEVICE_DIR.governs: the machine deck: coil / vessel geometry, diagnostic positions, limiter, Green response tables
FYLITE_DEVICE_DIR.needed_for: every capability that touches a machine (reconstruction, breakdown, feasible, discharge, coupled, vstab)
FYLITE_DEVICE_DIR.default: none - the deck is an INPUT and is not shipped; absent, those calls raise MachineDataMissing at the point of use
FYLITE_DEVICE_DIR.affects_result_why: names WHICH TOKAMAK is solved — every geometry, coil and Green table in the answer comes from this deck

FY_FACTS_PATH.governs: the facts search path: os.pathsep-separated corpora of assertions about named individuals, consulted in order
FY_FACTS_PATH.needed_for: nothing - a distribution may bundle one, and a checkout has its own facts/
FY_FACTS_PATH.default: the bundled fylite/_facts/ if present, then the checkout's facts/
FY_FACTS_PATH.affects_result_why: names WHICH corpus supplies each entry, and different corpora describe the same machine differently. Resolution is per entry and the first root wins the whole of it - document, card and rights ledger together - because a machine assembled half from one root and half from another is one nobody operates, produced without an error. The root that supplied each entry is recorded (fylite.facts.Entry.root) for the same reason a run manifest names its inputs.

FYLITE_NN_DIR.governs: where exported neural surrogates live (TGLF-NN and any other model in that family), as .npz written by tools/nn-export.jl
FYLITE_NN_DIR.needed_for: fylite.nn.load and every capability that asks for a surrogate; nothing else
FYLITE_NN_DIR.default: none - NO MODEL WEIGHTS ARE SHIPPED, and none are compiled into libfylite_kernel.so or the wasm: a surrogate is third-party DATA (TGLF-NN's sat2 ensemble is 3.5 MB) and is loaded on demand. Absent, fylite.nn raises NNDataMissing at the point of use
FYLITE_NN_DIR.affects_result_why: names WHICH TRAINED MODEL answers - a different export is a different function, and its own training box decides where the answer may be believed

FYLITE_RUN_DIR.governs: where runs are written (one directory per session, one per run inside it)
FYLITE_RUN_DIR.needed_for: nothing - it only moves the root
FYLITE_RUN_DIR.affects_result_why: only moves where the record is written

FYLITE_SESSION.governs: the session id runs group under, so several processes can share one session ledger
FYLITE_SESSION.needed_for: nothing - unset, one id is derived per process
FYLITE_SESSION.default: s-<utc>-<pid>, fixed for the life of the process
FYLITE_SESSION.affects_result_why: only groups records under an id

FY_KERNEL_LIB.governs: the native kernel library to load instead of the bundled one
FY_KERNEL_LIB.needed_for: nothing - the wheel ships the library
FY_KERNEL_LIB.affects_result_why: names which kernel binary computes the answer; its sha256 is recorded beside this, and the two together say what ran

FY_KERNEL_EXT_LIB.governs: the kernel EXTENSION library (TGLF + DKE) to load instead of the bundled one
FY_KERNEL_EXT_LIB.needed_for: nothing - a full install ships it; a CLI-only install deliberately does not
FY_KERNEL_EXT_LIB.affects_result_why: names which binary computes the turbulent and drift-kinetic answers. ★It must come from the same build as the core: the extension exports fylite_ext_abi_version and the loader refuses a pair that disagrees, because two libraries shipped apart can drift apart, and a drifted pair resolves a call to a signature that no longer matches - worse than not loading at all. Absent, the 15 TGLF/DKE entries refuse by name rather than raising AttributeError.

FY_RUNTIME_LIB.governs: the runtime (middle-layer) library to load instead of the bundled one — formats, assembly, plan->kernel->record, kernel loading. ★2026-09-04 renamed twice with the crate: FY_DATA_LIB -> FY_ENGINE_LIB -> FY_RUNTIME_LIB (fylite_data -> fylite_engine -> fylite_runtime, FYL-DESIGN-16 N-1 and N-2). `data` named two of the layer's six jobs; `engine` collided with the Python package `fylite.engine`, which is a different component. Neither old name is read any more
FY_RUNTIME_LIB.affects_result_why: names which binary READ the machine's numbers; a codec defect changes the values a run started from, and no later stage can tell
FY_RUNTIME_LIB.$note: ★2026-09-02 新增：数据平面从内核仓搬进本仓、成为独立的库（rust/fylite_runtime/）。它与 FY_KERNEL_LIB 指的是两份不同的 .so、两个不同的符号前缀（fylite_runtime_* / fylite_rs_*）。

KEFIT_MDS_SERVER.governs: the mdsip server for the EAST trees (`host` or `host:port`, port 8000 by default), read through the engine's read-only mdsip client
KEFIT_MDS_SERVER.needed_for: shot/time input modes (--east and a bare shot)
KEFIT_MDS_SERVER.affects_result_why: which server the measured shot is read from

KEFIT_LIMITER.governs: which limiter contour is used when none is named explicitly
KEFIT_LIMITER.affects_result_why: which limiter contour bounds the plasma when none is named — it changes the boundary, so it changes the equilibrium

RAYON_NUM_THREADS.affects_result_why: the kernel's parallel paths are per-element with identical arithmetic, so the thread count does not change a number — MEASURED 2026-08-26 end to end: `breakdown-iter` (30 scalars, 5 arrays) and `discharge-iter` (138 scalars, the full psi map) are bit-identical at 1 and 4 threads.  Recorded anyway, because the day that stops being true the record is what says which count produced which numbers
RAYON_NUM_THREADS.governs: how many threads rayon's ephemeral pool builds for the kernel's parallel paths
RAYON_NUM_THREADS.needed_for: nothing - unset, rayon uses the machine's available parallelism

FYLITE_KERNEL.governs: the kernel CHECKOUT (not the library): where a benchmark record's private gates run — `fylite cases --benchmark --run <ID>` executes `pytest tests/…` there, with fydata's oracle/ mounted at its tests/data
FYLITE_KERNEL.needed_for: fylite cases --benchmark --run only; listing, printing and --check of the public register need nothing
FYLITE_KERNEL.default: none - without it a --run is REFUSED BY NAME (the record's gates live in the private repository; the public side never re-derives a number a record claims)
FYLITE_KERNEL.affects_result_why: selects where the gates execute; the record's numbers are the register's, not this run's

FYDOC_ORACLE.governs: the reference store the public V&V register's pointers are relative to: fydoc's `oracle/` tree (it lived in fydata until 2026-09-04; the variable was renamed with it, and nothing in this package reads either name) (frozen answers, upstream release cases, reference tables) — the SAME tree both checkouts mount at tests/data; not `$FY_ORACLE_STORE` (that named its `oracle/oracle/` sub-tree, retired 2026-09-01)
FYDOC_ORACLE.needed_for: reading a record's `$FYDOC_ORACLE/…` pointer back to a file — `fylite.engine.benchmark.store_dir()` / `resolve_pointer()` read it via the module constant STORE_ENV.  The old name FYDATA_ORACLE is still honoured as a fallback and is declared separately below.
FYDOC_ORACLE.default: none - the store is private data and is not shipped; the pointer stays symbolic
FYDOC_ORACLE.affects_result_why: an address for the reader; the register carries each item's sha256 so a bound store can be verified, not substituted

FYDATA_ORACLE.governs: the SAME reference store as FYDOC_ORACLE, under the name it had before 2026-09-04 (the `oracle/` tree moved fydata -> fydoc and the variable was renamed with it); read only when FYDOC_ORACLE is unset
FYDATA_ORACLE.needed_for: keeping an existing deployment working across that rename — `fylite.engine.benchmark.store_dir()` falls back to it (module constant STORE_ENV_LEGACY), and `resolve_pointer()` also accepts `$FYDATA_ORACLE/…` pointers.  Renaming without honouring the old name would silently drop such a deployment back to `tests/data`: an unresolved pointer does not fail, it is merely not read.
FYDATA_ORACLE.default: none - FYDOC_ORACLE is the name to set for a new deployment

$note: The KEFIT_ prefix is the EFIT lineage's; the code that carried that name left with LICENSE 3.1 but these variables keep it because they are what an existing deployment sets.  ★★2026-09-01 移除四项：FY_ORACLE / FY_ORACLE_STORE / FY_ORACLE_PORT / KEFIT_REFERENCE_BUNDLE。它们的读者随 `fylite._oracle`、`fylite._port` 与 `_paths.reference_bundle()` 一起移除——冻结参考库是被移除求解器的输出，驱动私有检出的钩子不该从公开模块伸出去，而那个 ASIPP 参考包不可再分发。★这张表由 `tests/test_environment_table.py` 逐项核对「声明了就必须真的有人读」，所以删代码不删声明会红——本条就是那道闸抓出来的。★★2026-09-04 移除 KEFIT_MDS_ROOT：它选的是「本地树文件而不是服务器」，读者是站点的 MDSplus python 包（`MDSplus.Tree`）。在线路径改走中间层的 mdsip 客户端之后，本包不再 import 那个包——引擎说的是线上协议，不是树文件格式；而那个模式唯一指向过的本地树在已废弃的 `machine_desc/` 下。
